newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Red Crescent sends aid to Iran quake victims.
newsitem.headline: Turk Red Crescent sends aid to Iran quake victims.

text.p: Turkey's Red Crescent Society sent a truck-load of emergency aid to the thousands of earthquake victims in Iran on Wednesday, a statement from the organisation said.
The statement said that the shipment containing 100 tents, 3,500 blankets and medical supplies would be deliverd to the Iranian Red Crescent Society officials.
Iran's mountainous northwestern Ardabil province was hit by an earthquake on Friday, measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale, killing up to 1,000 people and injuring a more than 2,600.

It was followed by 500 aftershocks and another quake measuring 5.2 on Sunday. More than 35,000 people have been made homeless by the quake which completely destroyed 20 villages and damaged 80 others in the region.
